title: Add a sonar target to a project
description: Opts one project into Sonar analysis by adding a sonar target with its projectKey to project.json. The plugin infers the executor.

project.description: The Nx project that receives the sonar target.
project.x-prompt: Which project should be analysed by Sonar?

projectKey.description: The SonarQube project key. Defaults to the plugin's projectKeyPrefix option in nx.json followed by the project name.

projectName.description: The SonarQube project name. Omitted when not given, so the executor defaults it to projectKey.

tsconfig.description: The tsconfig the analysis reads, relative to the project root, used as given. Defaults to the first of tsconfig.sonar.json, tsconfig.lib.json and tsconfig.app.json that exists.

lcovReportPath.description: The lcov report, relative to the project root. Replaces the coverage/lcov.info default.

extraSources.description: Source folders appended to the default.

extraTests.description: Test folders appended to the default.

extraTestInclusions.description: Test inclusion globs appended to the default.

extraTsconfigPaths.description: Further tsconfig files appended after the chosen one.

extraExclusions.description: Exclusion globs appended to the default.

extraCoverageExclusions.description: Coverage exclusion globs appended to the default.

overwrite.description: Replace a sonar target the project already declares.

skipFormat.description: Skip formatting the files the generator changed.
